atoms.a: What factor do you think keeps the temperature of the UK mild?

feedback.end: The UK is surrounded by sea. The sea doesn’t heat up or cool down as quickly as land, so the UK has a mild climate.

instruction.text: Select the correct arrow to find out how wind direction affects the climate of different parts of the UK.

feedback.end: Cold air from polar regions means that northern parts of the UK have a cold climate.
Continental winds from mainland Europe keep the climate of eastern parts of the UK dry.
Hot, tropical air from the south creates a warm and wet climate in southern parts of the UK.
Western winds from the Atlantic Ocean keep the climate of western parts of the UK mild and wet.
